explanation: 该论文主要研究河流沉积物在三角洲平原上的滞留问题，涉及地理学和地质学领域，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）没有直接关系。
authors: J. H. Nienhuis;J. F. Paniagua‐Arroyave;F. E. Dunn;S. Cohen;T. E. Törnqvist
title: Global River Sediment Retention on Delta Plains
abstract: Fluvial sediments have helped form approximately 830,000 km2 of coastal deltaic land, a large part of which since the Holocene slowdown of global sea‐level rise. The rate at which deltas have retained fluvial sediment to build deltaic land, however, has varied greatly between different deltas. Sources of variability as well as global estimates of sediment retention remain poorly resolved, limiting the assessment of future delta change. Here, we compare delta area and thickness against fluvial sediment supply to derive estimates of delta plain sediment retention for ∼1,700 deltas, representing 93% of the global fluvial sediment supply. We find that 28% ± 14% (standard error of the mean) of the global fluvial sediment discharge is retained on delta plains, totaling 5.8 Gt per year, and equating to roughly 4.3 mm yr−1 as a global average sedimentation rate. The average delta, however, retains much less, about 4% ± 1%, because many smaller deltas do not retain much sediment. We observe a large difference between active and passive margins, with sediment retention much higher along the latter. Tide‐dominated deltas have the most efficient morphology, and retain 11% ± 4% on average but up to 70% when weighted by sediment flux. This is much higher than the 7% ± 2% and 2% ± 1% retained by river‐ and wave‐dominated deltas, respectively. As larger deltas retain a greater proportion of their supply, this study suggests a positive feedback that enables larger deltas to grow faster than smaller ones.

explanation: 该论文研究了西南英国海岸的氨气（NH3）空气-海面交换过程，涉及大气成分分析、沿海观测和空气质量监测，与大气环境遥感技术密切相关。
authors: S. Louw;T. G. Bell;E. M. S. Woodward;M. Yang
title: Ammonia Air‐Sea Exchange in Southwest UK
abstract: Ammonia (NH3) measurements are challenging to make, and air‐sea flux estimates are sparse, with coastal observations complicated by overlapping marine and terrestrial signals. Here we present high‐resolution NH3 air‐sea flux estimates based on two years (2022–2023) of atmospheric and seawater measurements at the Penlee Point Atmospheric Observatory (PPAO), on the southwest UK coast. NH3 concentrations peak in spring and summer and were strongly influenced by terrestrial air masses from the UK and Continental Europe. Net NH3 deposition occurred across all seasons, with seasonal median deposition ranging from 20.5 to 34.5 μmol m−2 d−1 or 1.0 to 1.8 kg NH3‐N ha−1 yr−1. The flux direction is primarily controlled by atmospheric NH3, while seasonal changes in seawater biogeochemistry have a secondary role. These findings highlight the role of anthropogenic NH3 in coastal nitrogen budgets and underscore the need for high‐resolution flux estimates.

explanation: 该论文主要研究海底热液系统和烃类演化，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）关系不大，更多关注地质和海洋化学领域。
authors: Y. Sakai;Y. Fukamatsu;V. J. Clementi;Y. Rosenthal;J. Gruetzner;S. Bünz;A. Plaza‐Faverola;K. St. John;R. G. Lucchi;T. A. Ronge;O. Libman‐Roshal;L. Monito;Y. Liu;M. Iizuka;L. Duxbury;L. Haygood;O. Tadai;G.‐I. Uramoto;W. Lin;Expedition 403 Shipboard Scientists
title: Million‐Year Scale Hydrothermal and Hydrocarbon Evolution Hosted Within Stratified Thermohydraulic Systems in Sedimented Ultraslow‐Spreading Settings, Svyatogor and Vestnesa Ridges
abstract: Hydrothermal systems at ultraslow‐spreading ridges are poorly understood, especially where thick sediments overlay detachment faults. The International Ocean Discovery Program Expedition 403 obtained the longest sediment record in Atlantic‐Arctic ultraslow‐spreading systems, reaching ∼628 m below the seafloor. Heat‐flow measurements, fluid geochemistry, and mineralogical analyses, combined with seismic interpretation, revealed thermohydraulic systems within two contourite drifts on ridge flanks. The Svyatogor Ridge site exhibits extreme heat flow and crustal‐fluid migration from two detachment faults, accompanied by newly documented thermogenic hydrocarbons, resulting in stratified thermohydraulic systems. The Vestnesa Ridge site exhibits moderate heat flow, and partial crustal‐fluid migration suggests developing thermohydraulic systems. The results reveal complex, long‐lived hydrothermal systems in the present day with significant, previously poorly understood reservoirs of geological carbon and suggest their million‐year‐scale evolution. This study advances understanding of fluid dynamics, fluid‐sediment interactions, and carbon cycling in sedimented ultraslow‐spreading ridge environments.

explanation: 该论文主要研究土壤呼吸对气候的响应，涉及机器学习模型和非线性关系，但未明确涉及大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析。
authors: Benjamin Laffitte;Zhihan Yang;Tao Zhou;Xiangjun Pei;Xiaolu Tang
title: Interpretable Machine Learning Reveals Global Nonlinear Responses of Soil Respiration to Climate
abstract: Soil respiration (Rs) is a major component of the global carbon cycle, yet its responses to environmental drivers remain poorly constrained. Using 8,111 observations and a SHAP‐interpreted Random Forest model, we identified global response patterns for key environmental drivers of Rs. Temperature contributions showed a peaked association with a descriptive maximum of 27.7°C, precipitation contributions plateaued at high values, and leaf area index contributions increased approximately linearly. These results provide a global, data‐driven characterization of peaked temperature and saturating precipitation associations, including how their shapes and supported ranges vary among climate zones. Our results indicate that monotonic assumptions in Earth system models may overlook important nonlinearities and potentially bias estimates of terrestrial carbon flux responses to seasonal climate extremes. Interpretable machine learning therefore provides a transparent framework for evaluating and improving the representation of soil carbon dynamics under climate change.

explanation: 该论文研究的是注入井口压力衰减与地震活动之间的关系，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）无关。
authors: R. Minetto;Z. Wang;O. Lengliné;J. Schmittbuhl
title: Analysis of the Correlation Between Post‐Injection Wellhead Pressure Decay and Trailing Seismicity
abstract: Fluid injection during reservoir stimulation aims to enhance reservoir permeability but induces seismic activity that persists for hours to months after injection has stopped. In this study, we investigate the correlation between the post‐injection wellhead pressure decay and the decrease in seismicity rate using data from multiple Enhanced Geothermal Systems injection operations characterized by an abrupt shut‐in. We evaluated several statistical models to represent the seismicity rate and the pressure decay. Using the best fitting model, we show that the time required to reach a given fraction of the initial seismicity rate and of the initial pressure are correlated, with the pressure relaxation being longer than the seismicity rate relaxation. No correlation is observed between seismicity decay and injection parameters such as injection volume, average injection pressure, or injection duration. These observations suggest that the relaxation of the pore pressure drives the decrease in seismicity, which has strong implications for reservoir management.

explanation: 该论文主要研究气候变暖对部落土地上洪水响应的影响，使用高分辨率水动力学模型进行模拟。虽然涉及大气环境变化，但重点在于洪水和水资源管理，而非大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析等。
authors: Tianjiao Pu;Gabriele Villarini;Renato S. Amorim;Donghui Li;Sudershan Gangrade;Martha Durr;Brandi Janssen
title: Flood Responses to Climate Warming on Tribal Lands Using High‐Resolution Hydrodynamic Modeling
abstract: Tribal nations across the United States face disproportionate flood impacts yet remain significantly underrepresented in national‐scale assessments, creating a critical equity gap in climate adaptation. We address this deficiency through a climate‐to‐local‐inundation framework for the Santee Sioux Nation, Nebraska, by forcing 10‐m hydrodynamic simulations with a 42‐year paired historical and pseudo‐global‐warming CONUS404 runoff event set. Results show that projected changes in inundation frequency and flood depth are limited, with no evidence of widespread intensification of flood extremes. Instead, changes manifest as localized adjustments in floodplain activation and tributary connectivity. Pixel‐wise return‐period analysis shows small changes in flood depth and only minor deviations in the statistical structure of extremes. These findings demonstrate a transferable pathway for translating climate‐driven hydrologic forcing into locally resolved inundation information for under‐mapped Tribal lands.

explanation: 这篇论文研究的是沙质浊流对有机碳的固定作用，特别是铁结合的有机碳（Fe-OC）的运输和保存。虽然涉及海洋沉积和地球化学过程，但没有直接提到大气环境遥感技术，如空气质量监测、卫星观测或大气成分分析。因此，它与大气环境遥感技术的关系不强。
authors: Zhuoyue Zhang;Chenglong Wang;Tianyu Chen;Rui Bao;Zicheng Chen;Xiao Huang;Yang Zhang;Xinqing Zou
title: Sandy Turbidity Current Acts as a Rusty Carbon Pump at the Shelf Edge
abstract: Sandy turbidity currents (STCs) efficiently sequester organic carbon (OC) through rapid burial. Yet our understanding of OC preservation within STC deposits remains far less constrained, especially considering STC deposits as an inferred major sink for iron‐bound OC (Fe‐OC), a long‐term stabilized form of OC. Here, we investigate a sediment core with five STC events from the northern slope of the South China Sea (SCS) and compare our observations against a globally compiled sedimentary Fe‐OC data set synthesized from published literature. We demonstrate that STC deposits host a higher Fe‐OC contribution (22.1% ± 7.6%) than background deposits. STCs drive rapid Fe‐OC transportation from shelf to slope under elevated accumulation rates (185.4 ± 84.6 g m−2 time−1). This process shields Fe‐OC from remineralization and favors the formation of refractory OC stabilized within iron matrices. We propose that STCs constitute a “rusty carbon pump,” and that continental slopes represent potential hotspots for long‐term Fe‐OC preservation.

explanation: 该论文主要研究近海淡水地下水分布受地形变化的影响，与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演）关系不大。
authors: Yi‐Peng Zhang;Anner Paldor
title: Offshore Freshened Groundwater Distribution Is Controlled by Along‐ and Cross‐Shore Topographic Variability
abstract: Offshore Freshened Groundwater (OFG) reservoirs are regarded as a potentially significant resource stored in continental shelves. While the role of subsurface geological conditions in controlling OFG has been widely recognized, the influence of the topography of the hosting continental shelf on OFG evolution remains poorly understood. Here, using generalized numerical modeling representative of a broad range of systems worldwide, we evaluate how the shelf slope affects the evolution of OFG in subsea aquifers, considering sea‐level rise over paleohydrogeological timescales. Our findings show that shallow dipping shelves are expected to have greater extents of OFG by up to 2.8 times and enhance the longevity of OFG preservation. Crucially, natural‐scale alongshore slope variability substantially influences the cross‐shore salt distribution. Considering alongshore flow shows that cross‐sectional analyses can overestimate OFG volumes by up to 3 times. These findings highlight the significance of shelf slope and lateral (alongshore) dynamics in estimating and predicting OFG resources.

explanation: 该论文研究木星中纬度黄昏磁层顶的磁重联现象，涉及空间物理和等离子体物理领域，与大气环境遥感技术中的卫星观测和磁场分析有间接关联，但主要聚焦于行星际磁层过程，而非直接针对大气成分、空气质量或卫星遥感技术。
authors: J. Montgomery;P. A. Delamere;A. R. Smith;C. Spitler;G. Fuller;R. W. Ebert;F. Allegrini;S. A. Fuselier;R. J. Wilson
title: Exploring Jupiter's Mid‐Latitude Dusk Magnetopause: The Impact of Magnetic Reconnection
abstract: The Juno mission has elucidated magnetosphere processes, structure, and dynamics via multi‐instrument plasma and magnetic field observations. In this study, these instruments are used to identify magnetic reconnection during the Juno extended mission from a survey of 490 magnetopause crossings at the mid‐latitude southern dusk magnetopause. This survey spans distances of 30–99 RJ, 14–20 local time, and 30°–65° in southern latitude. We identify reconnection outflow jets, plasma heating, and Hall magnetic fields as reconnection signatures while independently applying the Swisdak and Walén relations to each magnetopause crossing. Additionally, eastward versus westward interplanetary magnetic field (IMF) conditions are compared in this context. The results show that magnetic reconnection is most likely to occur during eastward IMF at the mid‐latitude dusk magnetopause due to favorable magnetic shear conditions. The identified eastward IMF reconnection events strongly adhere to the Walén relation, showing signatures of Alfvénic flow perturbations.

explanation: 该论文研究的是波浪与湍流混合的实验观察，涉及海洋中的混合机制，虽然主要关注的是海洋环境而非大气环境，但其研究方法（如激光诱导荧光、粒子图像测速等）与大气环境遥感技术中的某些技术有相似之处，尤其是在测量混合和传输方面。因此，可以认为它与大气环境遥感技术在某些方面是相关的。
topic_words: ['Langmuir turbulence', 'wave-induced Stokes drift', 'vertical transport', 'scalar flux', 'oceanic wave-induced mixing']
authors: O. Rømcke;P. Gautam;Ø. Breivik;M. P. Malila;R. J. Hearst;S. Å. Ellingsen
title: Direct Experimental Observation of Wave‐Amplified Turbulent Mixing
abstract: Langmuir turbulence is a key mechanism to enhanced mixing in the upper ocean. Although often associated with wind, the theoretical framework proposed by Craik and Leibovich requires only vorticity and wave‐induced Stokes drift, regardless of their cause. In a laboratory flume, we make waves of varying steepness interact with a turbulent current to measure the vertical transport of a passive scalar directly. Once waves appear, the turbulent flow changes radically with long, intense Langmuir (like) vortices forming near the surface, aligned with the wave direction. Combining stereo particle‐image velocimetry and laser‐induced fluorescence, we simultaneously measure the turbulent velocity field and the concentration field of a surface‐injected dye, showing dramatic enhancement and deepening of the vertical scalar flux, increasing with wave steepness. The Langmuir enhancement factor for mixing is measured in the range 4–6. The results are consistent with three different variants of the most‐used parameterization of oceanic wave‐induced mixing.

explanation: 该论文研究了澳大利亚的生物质燃烧对大气中羰基硫化物（OCS）的影响，涉及大气成分分析和生物质燃烧排放源，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测和大气成分分析密切相关。
authors: S. Kessler;N. Emig;H.‐C. Lachnitt;D. Kunkel;H. Bozem;V. Bense;P. Joppe;T. Kaluza;J.‐U. Grooß;A. Zahn;H. Ziereis;M. Riese;P. Hoor
title: Biomass Burning in Australia: No Evidence for Carbonyl Sulfide (OCS) Enhancement in Fire Plumes From In‐Situ Measurements During SouthTRAC
abstract: Determining the atmospheric abundance and the emission sources of carbonyl sulfide (OCS) plays a crucial role for the sulfur budget in the atmosphere. In addition to its main anthropogenic and biogenic sources, biomass burning is assumed to be an essential, but not well constrained source of OCS. From November 2019 onward extensive bushfires along the eastern coast of Australia released huge amounts of trace species into the atmosphere; during one flight of the SouthTRAC campaign air masses were observed carrying signatures of these fires along the southern coast of South America. An analysis of the composition of air masses inside and outside the plume revealed distinct differences in the trace species abundances. Specifically, our results indicate that OCS shows no enhancement in its atmospheric mixing ratio due to the Australian fires and thus highlights the varying emission strength of OCS for different types of biomass burning.

explanation: 该论文研究了西太平洋的上升气流诱导湍流（CIT）和非CIT，使用了机载实测数据和GK-2A卫星数据，这与大气环境遥感技术（如卫星观测和大气成分分析）密切相关。
authors: Sung‐Ho Baek;Jung‐Hoon Kim;Yoo‐Jeong Noh;Sang‐Moo Lee;Daehyun Kim;Hye‐Yeong Chun
title: Distinct Characteristics of Convectively Induced Turbulence (CIT) and Non‐CIT in the Western Pacific Using In Situ Aircraft Data and GK‐2A Satellite Data
abstract: This study introduces a newly defined turbulence patch that includes continuous turbulence reports of in situ aircraft data, separating at least 5‐min from others. This enables the individual turbulence patch to be characterized more easily by their possible sources than by an isolated data point. Using 5 years of satellite observations, we classified new turbulence patches into convectively induced turbulence (CIT) and non‐CIT. We also classified patches into long‐ and short‐duration events. Patch duration shows clear latitudinal differences, especially for CIT. CIT duration is linked to the size of underlying convective systems and strength of background winds. Signal analysis shows that CIT in low latitude exhibits a high skewness and kurtosis, indicating highly variable turbulence with occasional extreme fluctuations. Meanwhile, long‐duration non‐CIT patches occur frequently under enhanced Clear‐Air‐Turbulence (CAT) diagnostics, indicating an association between CAT‐prone conditions and encounter duration. These findings support turbulence risk assessment and nowcasting.

explanation: 该论文研究了有机气溶胶的水相处理过程，涉及大气环境中的气溶胶成分分析、二次有机气溶胶的形成和演化，这与大气环境遥感技术（如空气质量监测、气溶胶质量光谱仪等）密切相关。
authors: J. Trousdell;W. Jiang;J. Shilling;M. Shrivastava;J. D. Fast;Qi Zhang
title: Aqueous‐Phase Processing of Organic Aerosols at the Southern Great Plains: Insights From Integrated Chemical and Microphysical Analyses
abstract: Aqueous‐phase reactions are hypothesized to be a major pathway for secondary organic aerosol (SOA) formation in humid, cloud‐influenced environments, yet direct observational constraints remain limited. Here we investigated aqueous SOA (aqSOA) formation and evolution during the spring 2016 Holistic Interactions of Shallow Clouds, Aerosols, and Land Ecosystems (HI‐SCALE) campaign at the U.S. Department of Energy Southern Great Plains (SGP) site using high‐resolution aerosol mass spectrometer (HR‐AMS) measurements integrated with particle size distribution and meteorological observations. Positive matrix factorization (PMF) of HR‐AMS spectra resolved eight organic aerosol (OA) factors, including biomass burning OA (BBOA) factors with varying levels of oxidation, biogenic SOA (BSOArr), sulfate‐associated oxygenated OA (SOOA), nitrate‐associated oxygenated OA (NOOA), aged primary, anthropogenic OA, and nitrogen‐enriched OA. Four high RH periods associated with cloud presence and stable air masses were identified as favorable for aqueous processing, three of which were cloud‐ or humid‐boundary‐layer events with similar chemical evolution. During these events, SOOA, BSOA, and the most aged BBOA factor (BBOA3) collectively contributed 79% of OA mass (vs. 64% outside these events), with BSOA exhibiting the largest fractional increase. Growth‐rate analysis revealed size‐dependent particle growth consistent with volume‐controlled aqueous reactions. Correlations of aqSOA tracer ions (CHO+, CHO2+, CH2O2+, and C2H2O2+) with BBOA3 and BSOA, and CH3SO2+ with SOOA, further support aqSOA formation. These findings provide direct field evidence that aqueous‐phase chemistry significantly influences aerosol composition and evolution at SGP and demonstrate an integrated chemical‐microphysical framework for diagnosing aqSOA processing in ambient AMS data sets.

explanation: 该论文研究长波散射对辐射核的影响，涉及云和气溶胶粒子对红外辐射的散射，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测、卫星观测、大气成分分析、气溶胶反演等密切相关。研究结果表明长波散射对辐射核的影响，特别是对非云变量的辐射敏感性，对地球能量收支和气候敏感性有重要影响，这与大气环境遥感技术的应用领域高度相关。
topic_words: ['longwave scattering', 'radiative kernels', 'cloud and aerosol particles', 'atmospheric model', 'climate feedbacks']
authors: Han Huang;Yi Huang;Jason N. S. Cole;Jiangnan Li
title: Longwave Scattering Effects on Radiative Kernels
abstract: Longwave (LW) scattering, the redirection of infrared radiation by cloud and aerosol particles, is often neglected in current global climate models (GCMs). However, studies have suggested that LW scattering can influence the Earth's energy budget and climate sensitivity, indicating a need to improve the representation and understanding of this radiative effect. In addition to mean radiative fluxes, LW scattering can also change radiative sensitivities as quantified by radiative kernels. This aspect of the LW scattering effect, especially on the radiative sensitivity of non‐cloud variables, has remained largely unexplored. In this study, we use the Canadian Atmospheric Model (CanAM) which accounts for LW scattering to investigate how it affects broadband and spectral flux radiative kernels and subsequently biases kernel‐diagnosed climate feedbacks. Our results show that LW scattering generally weakens the non‐cloud kernels, reducing the sensitivity of TOA and surface radiative fluxes to non‐cloud feedback variables, with the reduction being stronger at the TOA than at the surface. The largest impact occurs in the water vapor TOA kernel, especially in the far‐infrared region. Consistent with these radiative kernel changes, non‐cloud radiative feedbacks diagnosed using radiative kernels are weaker when LW scattering is included. On the other hand, the cloud feedback is enhanced, corroborating earlier findings.

explanation: 该论文研究的是北极夏季季内振荡（BSISO）和厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）对热带西太平洋（TWNP）中尺度扰动强度的影响，涉及大气环流和天气系统的变化，这与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测、卫星观测和大气成分分析等领域有直接关联。
topic_words: ['synoptic-scale disturbances', 'boreal summer intraseasonal oscillation', 'ENSO', 'tropical western north pacific']
authors: Qinlu Gu;Renguang Wu
title: Individual and Combined Impacts of Boreal Summer Intraseasonal Oscillation and ENSO on Tropical Western North Pacific Synoptic‐Scale Disturbance Intensity
abstract: Synoptic‐scale disturbances (SSDs) over tropical western North Pacific (TWNP) are subjected to impacts of boreal summer intraseasonal oscillation (BSISO) and El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO). This study investigates individual and combined impacts of BSISO and ENSO on the SSD intensity over TWNP. It is found that the impact of the BSISO wet phase on the SSD intensity is pronouncedly different in El Niño and La Niña years, whereas the SSD intensity in the BSISO dry phase is relatively less sensitive to ENSO. El Niño and La Niña induce different SSD intensity changes in the BSISO wet phase. El Niño leads to an increase and eastward shift of large SSD intensity. This is attributed to the increase and eastward shift of cyclonic lower‐level wind fields and consequently the barotropic energy conversion from background lower‐level wind fields to SSDs. La Niña leads to an increase and northward shift of large SSD intensity. This results from a shift of cyclonic lower‐level wind fields and associated barotropic energy conversion from background lower‐level wind fields to SSDs to northwestern TWNP. In the BSISO dry phase, the background lower‐level wind fields are anticyclonic and the ENSO effects are small due to unfavorable background field. This accounts for the relatively small ENSO effect on the SSD intensity in the BSISO dry phase.

explanation: 该论文与大气环境遥感技术密切相关，因为它涉及气溶胶光学属性（AOPs）、社区辐射传输模型（CRTM）、气溶胶光学深度（AOD）以及卫星反演算法（如暗目标法和深蓝法）。这些内容直接与空气质量监测、卫星观测和大气成分分析相关。
topic_words: ['Aerosol Optical Properties', 'Community Radiative Transfer Model', 'Aerosol Optical Depth', 'Dark Target', 'Deep Blue']
authors: Cheng Dang;Soyoung Ha;Cheng‐Hsuan Lu;Quanhua Liu;Patrick Stegmann;Yingtao Ma;Shih‐Wei Wei;Jeffrey S. Reid;Yingxi Shi;Andrew M. Sayer;Peng Xian;Jaehwa Lee;Jérôme Barré;Maryam Abdi‐Oskouei;Benjamin T. Johnson
title: Aerosol Optical Properties in the Community Radiative Transfer Model for Data Assimilation
abstract: Aerosol particles have significant impacts across the Earth System, yet quantifying these impacts remains challenging. An effective technique to predict aerosol distribution and study their impact is data assimilation (DA), for which the aerosol optical properties (AOPs) are critical. AOPs govern the interaction of light with aerosols, serve as the fundamental parameters in aerosol retrieval algorithms, and link the modeled aerosol concentration to retrieval products, such as aerosol optical depth (AOD). Ensuring consistent and scientifically accurate AOPs across aerosol models, observation, and observation operators is therefore essential for aerosol DA. To support this need, on top of the default aerosol scheme developed and adopted by NOAA, the Community Radiative Transfer Model (CRTM) team has implemented and released three optional aerosol schemes in recent years to facilitate aerosol DA with the Community Multiscale Air Quality, NAAPS, and GOCART‐GEOS5 models. In this paper, we present updates to the CRTM aerosol component, examine the impacts of different aerosol schemes on simulated AOD and brightness temperature, and compare the AOPs used in the selected chemical transport model and satellite retrieval algorithms, including Dark Target and Deep Blue. This work aims to better constrain AOPs across selected DA systems and discusses the recent progress as well as remaining challenges.

explanation: 该论文研究了南大洋的矿物尘和黑碳气溶胶特性，涉及了空气质量的直接观测和气溶胶分类，与大气环境遥感技术中的空气质量监测和气溶胶分析密切相关。
topic_words: ['mineral dust', 'black carbon', 'Southern Ocean', 'airborne water-insoluble particles', 'complex amplitude sensor']
authors: A. Yoshida;Y. Tobo;H. Kobayashi;K. Adachi;N. Moteki;J. Inoue
title: Shipborne Measurements of Mineral Dust and Black Carbon Aerosols Over the Southern Ocean in the Austral Summer
abstract: Atmospheric mineral dust and black carbon (BC) aerosols play important roles in the Earth's climate system, yet direct observations over the Southern Ocean (SO) are scarce. In this study, we present the characteristics of airborne water‐insoluble particles (WIPs) collected during a cruise of the R/V Shirase in the Australian and Indian sectors of the SO from December 2022 to March 2023. Using a complex amplitude sensor, we measured complex scattering amplitude of individual WIPs to classify into dust‐like (0.50–2.5 μm in diameter) and BC‐like (0.15–0.50 μm in diameter) particles. The mass concentrations of dust‐like and BC‐like aerosols were 0.0–6.4 ng m−3 and 0.079–3.8 ng m−3, respectively. The highest concentrations of both were observed when the R/V Shirase was located in a mid‐latitude region closest to Australia, indicating strong influence of the emission from mid‐latitude sources. The lowest concentration of BC‐like aerosols was observed in a sample collected when the ship was near the Antarctic coast and the air mass would be rarely influenced by mid‐latitude emissions. However, the dust‐like aerosol concentration in the same sample was relatively higher than that collected in the most remote offshore region away from both mid‐latitude and Antarctic continents, suggesting a potential source of dust aerosols. Despite a case study based on a limited number of samples, this study fills an observational gap by providing quantitative data of mineral dust and BC aerosols over the SO, providing new insights into their sources and climate effects.

title: No Net Increase in Ecosystem Water Limitation Under Greenhouse Warming
abstract: Energy and water availability are essential controls on terrestrial ecosystem functions such as evapotranspiration. Accurately identifying the dominant regime of water or energy limitation on evapotranspiration is crucial for understanding ecosystem responses to climate change. Recent studies using Earth System Model (ESM) projections suggest widespread shifts from energy‐ to water‐limited conditions under global warming. We demonstrate that incorporating a thermodynamically appropriate energy indicator fundamentally changes this projection. Surface energy availability for evapotranspiration and related ecosystem functions is primarily determined by net radiation (Rn) rather than downwelling shortwave radiation or air temperature. Using this Rn‐based ecosystem limitation framework, we find no significant net increase in projected water limitation on either evapotranspiration or transpiration toward the end of the century. Idealized ESM CO2 experiments attribute this pattern to CO2‐induced physiological effects on vegetation—primarily stomatal regulation and enhanced water‐use efficiency—that largely dampen the increased water limitation from enhanced radiative forcing under greenhouse warming. Key physiological variables such as net primary production and leaf area index also show coherent and mechanistically interpretable responses to shifts in Rn‐based water–energy limitation regimes in transitional zones. These findings are consistent with patterns reported in other ecohydrologically based studies and are supported by empirical evidence of reduced vegetation sensitivity to dry conditions under elevated CO2. Our study bridges ecological and physical theories to improve ecosystem water‐energy limitation analysis and provides a clear mechanistic understanding of future ecosystem dynamics.

title: Adaptation Potential of Local Water Management Practices to Glacier Loss
abstract: Climate change disproportionately affects mountain river basins, driving cryospheric changes and altering their hydrology. This has detrimental impacts on water resources, accentuating the need for robust adaptation strategies. Traditional engineering approaches can provide buffering capacity but are associated with high costs and limited flexibility. At the same time, local, small scale water management practices are gaining attention, yet evidence on their effectiveness remains limited. We evaluate the adaptation potential of common local practices, that is, headwater grassland regeneration, small surface storage, and artificial recharge, in the Vilcanota‐Urubamba system, Peru. We find that, if properly managed, these interventions can substantially contribute to seasonal and interannual hydrological buffering and dry season water availability. However, when implemented in isolation, they are unlikely to fully offset climate impacts. Our results support the design of catchment‐scale intervention portfolios for adaptation planning, with a combination of large, centralized infrastructure and distributed local interventions likely to provide the most effective solution.

title: Breaking water-structure constraints by Hofmeister effects in interfacial polymerization for polyamide membranes
abstract:
Water structures govern the behaviour of solutes across aqueous bulk and interfacial environments. Here the authors use weakly hydrated anions to reshape hydration in the bulk and at interfaces, thereby regulating amine monomer partitioning and interfacial transport while suppressing acyl chloride hydrolysis during polyamide-forming interfacial polymerization. 
 Hydration critically governs the physicochemical behavior of solutes in both the aqueous bulk and interfacial environments. As typical chaotropic Hofmeister ions, weakly hydrated anions (WHAs) can reshape hydration structures and accumulate at water–hydrophobe interfaces. Notably, WHAs paradoxically suppress the solubility of certain small-molecule monomers in water while enhancing that of chemically analogous polymers. Here, we exploit WHA-mediated Hofmeister hydration control to regulate polyamide-forming interfacial polymerization (IP), using the piperazine (PIP) and trimesoyl chloride (TMC) nanofiltration system as the primary model. Introducing WHAs into the aqueous phase reduces the affinity of amine monomers for water and accelerates partitioning into the reaction front in the oil phase, remarkably reinforcing IP self-limitation. Simultaneously, interfacial WHA enrichment lowers interfacial tension and, together with accelerated amine delivery, potentially intensifies transport-driven interfacial instabilities. WHAs also lower interfacial water availability, attenuating acyl chloride hydrolysis. These synergistic effects yield hollow-ridged polyamide selective layers with reduced thickness and high crosslinking density, delivering enhanced water permeance and salt rejection. Crucially, module-scale fabrication of high-performance membranes demonstrates that WHA-mediated Hofmeister hydration control is directly compatible with established desalination pipelines. Water structures govern the behaviour of solutes across aqueous bulk and interfacial environments. Here the authors use weakly hydrated anions to reshape hydration in the bulk and at interfaces, thereby regulating amine monomer partitioning and interfacial transport while suppressing acyl chloride hydrolysis during polyamide-forming interfacial polymerization.

title: Spatially resolving isomeric trisaccharides on surfaces with Orbitrap-SIMS
abstract:
Structural isomers can be difficult to distinguish and map by mass alone. This study shows that Orbitrap-SIMS can separate and image isomeric sugars directly on surfaces, offering a new route to study complex biomolecules. 
 Many biologically important molecules are structural isomers that share the same molecular mass yet differ in shape, bonding and function. This creates an ambiguity for mass spectrometry imaging (MSI), where chemically distinct species can be indistinguishable on the mass-to-charge (m/z) scale and therefore cannot be reliably mapped in heterogeneous materials. Here we demonstrate that Orbitrap secondary ion mass spectrometry (OrbiSIMS) can provide an orthogonal contrast that enables both identification and spatial separation of isomeric molecules directly on surfaces. By exploiting structure-dependent secondary-ion dissociation and gas-phase collisional effects during ion transmission, we discriminate isomeric trisaccharides raffinose, maltotriose and melezitose and spatially resolve raffinose and maltotriose in mixtures. We benchmark these measurements against ion mobility spectrometry and observe consistent trends between OrbiSIMS transmission behaviour and ion mobility separation. These results establish OrbiSIMS as an approach for isomer-resolved MSI at surfaces and interfaces, opening opportunities to map isomeric biomolecules in complex systems where spatial distribution is central to function. title: Optical-handedness-driven enantioselective synthesis and programmable chirality encoding of covalent organic frameworks
abstract:
Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) typically require chiral precursors or catalysts to achieve asymmetry. Here, the authors report the enantioselective synthesis of chemically chiral COFs using circularly polarized light as the sole chiral director. 
 Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) typically require chiral precursors or catalysts to achieve asymmetry. Here, we report the enantioselective synthesis of chemically chiral COFs using circularly polarized light (CP-λ) as the sole chiral director. By exploiting the reversibility of imine condensation, a dynamic self-correction process amplifies the photonic chiral bias into long-range crystalline order without any chiral auxiliaries. Unlike conventional strategies that rely on localized chiral centers, our approach induces chirality directly within the emissive framework backbone. This structural integration results in a luminescence dissymmetry factor of 0.24, representing a substantial value for purely organic systems. Furthermore, we demonstrate spatially programmable encoding with sub-micrometer resolution, enabling the transcription of complex enantiomeric patterns into the frameworks. This methodology establishes a reagent-free platform for the manufacturing of chiral crystalline materials and advances the development of programmable photonic devices. title: Brassinosteroids improve nitrogen utilization by antagonizing BIN2-mediated SnRK1 activation
abstract:
Brassinosteroids are widely used in agriculture, but their modes of action remain incompletely understood. Here, the authors show that brassinosteroids inhibit BIN2, leading to KIN10 degradation and activation of gene expression and nitrogen assimilation enzymes. 
 Nitrogen is an essential nutrient for plant growth and development, and is central to increasing crop yield. Brassinosteroids (BRs) and their analogs are widely used in agriculture to enhance crop yields and improve nitrogen utilization, yet the underlying mechanism remains fragmentary. Here, we demonstrate that BR conservatively improves nitrogen utilization by modulating the activity of SnRK1, an evolutionarily conserved regulator balancing carbon and nitrogen metabolism. Exogenous BR application increases plant biomass and nitrogen utilization, and enhances key nitrogen assimilation enzyme activities when photosynthesis is inhibited. Metabolomic reveals that BR restores 47.8% of metabolic alterations caused by photosynthetic suppression. Mechanistically, BIN2, a key kinase in BR signaling, interacts with and phosphorylates KIN10, the catalytic α-subunit of SnRK1, at conserved Thr175 and Ser179, thereby stabilizing KIN10. BR inhibits BIN2, promoting KIN10 degradation and thereby activating nitrate-responsive gene expression and enhancing nitrogen assimilation. These findings reveal how BR signaling enhances nitrogen utilization and offer insights for improving crop productivity and sustainability. title: Size-dependent catalysis of Ru nanoparticles for selective reductive amination of PET plastic
abstract:
Turning waste plastic into valuable chemicals requires precise control of competing reactions. This study shows that tuning ruthenium particle size enables selective conversion of polyethylene terephthalate into p-xylylenediamine. 
 Converting waste polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic into high-value p-xylylenediamine (PXDA) is a revolutionary solution to alleviate energy shortages and plastic pollution. However, current catalytic methods are often limited by poor chemoselectivity due to uncontrolled reductive amination and hydrodeoxygenation capabilities. Herein, we report a precision strategy to regulate the aggregation state of Ru on nitrogen-doped carbon, enabling size-dependent control of reaction pathways in the reductive amination of PET. Ultrasmall Ru nanoclusters (~1.3 nm) favor over-hydrogenation to 1,4-cyclohexanedimethanamine, whereas larger Ru nanoparticles (~4.6 nm) promote excessive hydrodeoxygenation to p-xylene. Notably, Ru/NC-SNPs (~2.4 nm) gives a high PXDA yield of 95.5% with a low apparent activation barrier (30.8 kJ/mol) under mild conditions. Mechanistic studies indicate that Ru/NC-SNPs achieve an optimal balance between hydrogen activation and amidation activity, thereby enabling selective amidation through the controlled dehydrogenation of the amide intermediate. The catalyst also demonstrates broad applicability for post-consumer PET, mixed plastics containing PET and other polyester plastics. Techno-economic analysis and life-cycle assessments further confirm the economic viability and environmental benefits of this process. This work establishes a size-governed selectivity paradigm for Ru-based catalysts and provides a general strategy for steering competing pathways in heterogeneous reductive amination toward sustainable PET valorization. This study shows that tuning ruthenium particle size enables selective conversion of polyethylene terephthalate into p-xylylenediamine.

title: ADAM17 is a broad HIV-1 restriction factor targeted by Nef to restore Env maturation
abstract:
Here, the authors show that the cell-surface protein ADAM17 blocks HIV-1 by preventing maturation of the viral envelope protein, while the viral protein Nef counteracts this effect by redirecting ADAM17 out of infected cells. 
 HIV-1 uses the accessory protein Nef to enhance the infectivity of newly produced virus particles, but the host defenses counteracted by Nef remain incompletely defined. The membrane protein SERINC5 contributes to this defense but primarily restricts laboratory-adapted HIV-1 strains, suggesting that other cellular factors influence the requirement for Nef. Here we show that ADAM17, a cell-surface protein best known for cleaving inflammatory mediators, restricts both laboratory-adapted and primary HIV-1 isolates. ADAM17 acts independently of its enzymatic activity: its signal peptide, which normally directs proteins into the cellular secretory pathway, binds the HIV-1 envelope precursor gp160 and retains it in the endoplasmic reticulum. This prevents envelope maturation, transport to the cell surface and incorporation into virus particles, thereby reducing viral infectivity. Nef counteracts this restriction through a PxxP protein-interaction motif that promotes the release of ADAM17 in extracellular vesicles, reducing its abundance within cells and restoring envelope maturation. Disruption of ADAM17 in CD4-positive T-cell lines and primary human lymphocytes reduced the requirement for Nef during viral replication. These findings establish ADAM17 as a regulator of HIV-1 envelope production and show how Nef redirects host-cell trafficking to promote the formation of infectious virus particles. title: Metabolic reprogramming of macrophage-specific transketolase orchestrates angiogenesis in diabetic wounds
abstract:
Diabetes impairs wound healing by disrupting macrophage metabolism and angiogenesis. Here, authors identify macrophage-specific transketolase (TKT) as a metabolic checkpoint and develop a nanozyme hydrogel that restores macrophage TKT to promote vascular repair in diabetic wounds. 
 Diabetic wound healing is profoundly impaired by macrophage metabolic dysfunction, which compromises angiogenesis. Here, we show a macrophage transketolase (TKT) as a crucial metabolic checkpoint governing vascular regeneration in diabetes. We demonstrate that loss of TKT in macrophages accelerates amino acid and fatty acid catabolism, elevates reactive oxygen species, and disrupts endothelial cell proliferation and differentiation. Mechanistically, hyperglycemia activates the AGEs-RAGE signaling cascade through suppressing TKT expression, establishing a pathological TKT-AGEs-RAGE axis that reprograms macrophage metabolism toward dysfunction. Then, we engineer a nanozyme-integrated hydrogel patch that selectively increases TKT level in macrophages, which rebalances macrophage metabolism, reduces oxidative stress, and rescues angiogenic capacity. In a diabetic pig model, localized delivery of the nano-system markedly accelerates wound closure and vascular repair. These findings not only elucidate a macrophage-specific TKT metabolic reprogramming mechanism for enhancing angiogenesis, but also offer a potential therapeutic strategy for the clinical management of diabetic wounds. Here, authors identify macrophage-specific transketolase (TKT) as a metabolic checkpoint and develop a nanozyme hydrogel that restores macrophage TKT to promote vascular repair in diabetic wounds.

title: Nonflammable sulfamoyl–carbonate hybrid electrolyte for high-voltage lithium batteries via preemptive passivation
abstract:
Batteries require safe electrolytes without compromising performance. Here, the authors develop a nonflammable sulfamoyl–carbonate hybrid electrolyte for high-voltage, long-lasting, and safe lithium-ion batteries. 
 Achieving high energy density without compromising safety remains a significant challenge for advanced batteries. Nonflammable electrolytes can mitigate fire risk, but poor bulk and interfacial properties of such electrolytes limit their application. Here, a nonflammable sulfamoyl–carbonate electrolyte was developed, achieving a self-extinguishing time of ~0 s and stable cycling in both lithium metal and lithium-ion batteries under high-voltage conditions. The electrolyte comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in dimethylsulfamoyl fluoride, fluoroethylene carbonate, and ethyl methyl carbonate at low concentration establishes a weakly solvating environment, wherein dimethylsulfamoyl fluoride and fluoroethylene carbonate preferentially contribute to stabilize the positive and negative electrodes, while working together to enhance the rate capability, low-temperature performance, and long-term cycling at high-voltage. Accelerating rate calorimetry revealed a delayed thermal runaway onset by 87 °C, correlating with Broadness Index. These findings suggest that preemptive passivation on both electrodes, when coupled with nonflammable electrolyte design, can provide a viable route toward safe, high-energy lithium batteries. Batteries require safe electrolytes without compromising performance. Here, the authors develop a nonflammable sulfamoyl–carbonate hybrid electrolyte for high-voltage, long-lasting, and safe lithium-ion batteries.

title: Material circularity implications of battery degradation in shared electric mobility
abstract:
Shared mobility aims to save materials, yet intensive use accelerates battery degradation and may alter these savings. This study assesses the implications of shared mobility by coupling fleet projections, battery degradation and dynamic material flow analysis in China. 
 The electrification of passenger transport is central to climate mitigation but increases demand for critical minerals. Shared electric mobility and circular strategies could ease this pressure, yet intensive use accelerates battery degradation and may alter their benefits. Here we integrate province-resolved fleet projections, degradation modelling and dynamic material flow analysis to assess battery material demand and circularity in China. We show that the material benefits of shared mobility depend on battery chemistry. For lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC811) batteries, it reduces cumulative lithium savings by 2060 from 5.3–8.1 Mt under static lifetime assumptions to 2.6–4.7 Mt. More durable lithium iron phosphate and lithium nickel cobalt aluminium oxide batteries preserve or amplify material savings. Our analysis reveals a temporal trade-off. Shared mobility accelerates battery retirement and boosts secondary material supply, while second-life battery use delays recycling, constrains secondary supply to vehicle manufacturing and increases near-term demand for primary resources. Accounting for battery degradation is therefore critical to aligning shared mobility, battery choice and circular strategies with transport decarbonization. title: Artificial intelligence for life-cycle-aware sustainable materials discovery
abstract:
Materials discovery by artificial intelligence rarely considers scalability, environmental impacts or end-of-life management, prioritizing functional performance. This Perspective suggests a roadmap for embedding life-cycle considerations in the discovery process to design sustainable materials from the start. 
 Artificial intelligence has accelerated the discovery of new materials, offering a route towards sustainable development. Candidates are nevertheless evaluated almost exclusively on functional performance. Whether a material can be manufactured at scale, how it behaves once built into a real product, what burden its production places on the environment and what becomes of it at the end of its life are questions addressed only after the choice has been settled, when little can be altered. Bringing these considerations into the discovery process itself is achievable and would yield materials that are sustainable not by accident but by design. This Perspective suggests a roadmap for embedding life-cycle considerations in the discovery process to design sustainable materials from the start.

title: Small-molecule-bound biopolymer networks for sustainable multifunctional composites
abstract:
Combining biomaterials of different nature can yield sustainable composites with otherwise inaccessible properties. This study presents a strategy to overcome interfacial mismatch between individual components, enabling efficient structural integration within mechanically strong, multifunctional films. 
 Multicomponent biopolymer networks are promising platforms for developing sustainable materials. However, weak coupling across mismatched heterointerfaces of different biomaterials limits structural coherence, load transfer and functional integration. Here we establish a natural small-molecule-mediated non-covalent heterointerfacial reorganization strategy and validate it using a collagen–Ganoderma lucidum mycelium–plant-derived anthocyanin (CMpA) model system. By combining molecular simulations, interfacial spectroscopy, mesoscale structural analysis and mechanical modelling, we resolve a cross-scale pathway in which anthocyanin-associated non-covalent contacts at local heterointerfaces are translated into pore-wall consolidation, lamellar orientational coherence and continuous load transfer. This cross-scale structural integration yielded CMpA films with a tensile strength of 63.55 MPa, along with UV-shielding, antioxidant and antibacterial properties, reduced oxygen and water-vapour transmission, and pH-responsive freshness indication, making them promising candidates for active and intelligent packaging. More broadly, the work links small-molecule-mediated local interfacial chemistry with mesoscale anisotropic network formation and macroscopic functional integration, offering a design principle for sustainable biopolymer materials that require both mechanical coherence and multifunctionality. title: Subglacial landforms as proxy for offshore freshened groundwater in formerly glaciated margins
abstract:
Regionally extensive offshore freshened groundwater systems linked to past glaciation can be predicted by subglacial landforms, suggests a study that integrated controlled-source electromagnetic data with high-resolution seismic reflection surveys in the southeastern North Sea. 
 Offshore freshened groundwater (OFG) is a significant yet underexplored component of the global water cycle, and its spatial distribution, particularly its links to past glacial processes, remains poorly constrained. The southeastern North Sea, characterized by extensive tunnel valley networks, provides an ideal setting to test how Pleistocene meltwater shaped offshore groundwater systems. Using newly acquired time-domain controlled-source electromagnetic data integrated with high-resolution seismic reflection surveys, we present a resistivity-based mapping of OFG in this region. The models reveal a laterally continuous OFG body with resistivities of 8–14 Ω·m, extending across multiple stratigraphic units and well beyond individual subglacial landforms. This configuration is best explained by subglacial meltwater flushing of sediment porewaters during Pleistocene glaciations. Subsequent preservation was aided by density contrasts that limit vertical mixing and by fine-grained glaciomarine deposits sealing the system from above. The connection between resistivity anomalies and mapped subglacial landforms shows that the latter can serve as predictive proxies for OFG occurrence. These findings shift the perspective from OFG as isolated anomalies to regionally extensive systems linked to glacial processes, establishing subglacial landforms as a testable screening proxy for locating OFG in formerly glaciated margins worldwide. Regionally extensive offshore freshened groundwater systems linked to past glaciation can be predicted by subglacial landforms, suggests a study that integrated controlled-source electromagnetic data with high-resolution seismic reflection surveys in the southeastern North Sea.
